sentences.text: Present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India has been filed for issuance of a writ of mandamus against respondents directing them not to raise any construction upon the land which is of the ownership of the present petitioner without acquiring the same and on payment of compensation under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been argued by counsel for the petitioner that a show cause notice dated 09.11.2022 was issued by corporation whereby, he has been asked to submit documents with regard to his ownership of the land which is creating obstruction in construction of a road.

In pursuance to the show cause notice, reply was submitted vide Annexure P/7, but till date it had not been decided and petitioner apprehends that the respondents may acquire the land and demolish his house.

Per contra, learned Govt. Advocate submits that from perusal of reply, it appears that it was submitted on 01.09.2022 which is prior to the date of issuance of show cause notice i.e. 09.11.2022 and also there is no endorsement of receiving by the corporation and for the grievance raised by the petitioner, he first has to approach the authorities and submit his reply.
He further submits that present petition as such, is not maintainable against a show cause notice.

Looking to the short controversy involved in the matter, though the petition in the present form is not maintainable, in the interest of justice, the petitioner is directed to move to the concerning authority and submit the relevant documents which have been sought vide notice annexure P/1 dated 09.11.2022 and in turn, the corporation thereafter is free to take decision in accordance with law.
With the aforesaid directions, this petition stands disposed of.

(MILIND RAMESH PHADKE) JUDGE Rks RAM KUMAR SHARMA 2023.01.12 10:36:31 +05'30'
